verdict.rationale: Lambda's documented compute offerings are always-on GPU virtual machines (On-Demand Cloud), 1-Click Clusters, and Managed Kubernetes/Slurm, all billed by running time. Nothing in the evidence describes serverless GPU workers, request-driven autoscaling, or scale-to-zero. A community report confirms that running instances are billed whether idle or in use, and the user's request for auto-stop went unanswered, which is the always-on model this story wants to avoid. API-based instance launch and cluster schedulers are building blocks, not the serverless capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy code to autoscaling serverless GPU workers that scale to zero, instead of managing always-on instances
